title: HVAC and Plumbing in Boerne, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Boerne, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we provide trusted HVAC and plumbing services to the Boerne, TX community. With over three decades of experience, we handle everything from heating and cooling system installations to plumbing repairs and maintenance. We pride ourselves on transparent, reliable service and strive to make every customer feel like family. Whether it’s a sudden plumbing emergency or routine HVAC upkeep, your home’s comfort depends on a dependable system. Let us ensure your heating, cooling, and plumbing needs are completely taken care of.

Homeowners in Boerne count on their heating and cooling systems to stay comfortable during the most intense weather extremes. The team at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air provides ongoing care through our Comfort Club Membership, which includes both a spring cooling tune-up and a fall heating tune-up. These visits focus on preventing efficiency losses, extending system life, and limiting the chances of unexpected breakdowns. Members also receive benefits such as discounted repair pricing, priority scheduling, reduced service fees, and no overtime charges. For households with multiple systems, the Enhanced Maintenance Plan is available and expands coverage to include a free annual drain line clearing and a lifetime thermostat warranty.

Qualified borrowers looking to spread out the cost of a major repair or replacement can get financing on approved credit. We’ve been recognized by industry leaders and have an excellent service record: an A+ rating with the BBB, ACCA Residential Contractor of the Year in 2021, and thousands of positive customer reviews.

Plumbing systems in Boerne homes face demands that range from heavy water use during the summer months to mineral buildup in hard water areas. To manage these challenges, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air offers a Plumbing Maintenance Program that includes an annual water heater flush, inspections, and several tests of plumbing performance. These services help identify issues such as sediment buildup, high pressure that strains pipes, or slow leaks that can lead to wasted water and higher bills. Membership also provides discounts on plumbing repairs throughout the year.

Just like our HVAC services, financing is available on approved credit for plumbing projects, allowing you to plan for upgrades or unexpected replacements. With structured maintenance and flexible payment options, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air keeps your plumbing system running smoothly year after year.
When you need a top HVAC technician or a plumbing pro in Boerne, call the Rosenberg Plumbing & Air team!
